svg.title: A commit records a snapshot.
svg.desc: A commit records a snapshot of selected file versions in local history. In an initialized repository with identity configured, the previous commit's note.txt contains hello; the saved working and staged file now also contain again, continuing the staging page. git diff has no output because no unstaged edit remains; git diff --cached shows the staged added line. A complete commit command records it. A labelled timeline connects the earlier commit to the new snapshot. Tracked and untracked files and the cached diff option are defined.
svg.text: A commit saves the selected file versions as a snapshot in local history.
Here: repository initialized, identity set; committed note.txt held hello.
As on the staging page, again is already staged. Tracked = known to Git.
no output: no unstaged edits here
--cached compares the staged versions to the last commit.
Untracked = not yet staged or committed; git diff omits these new files.
git log shows commits. Recorded locally, not automatically uploaded.
